author: fresh semantic-v3 fictional data author; inherited workhorse fallback; exact model version unavailable

construction_requirements: Open date complement versus a completed complement, without forcing same punctuation pattern across classes.
Complete vague period/reference versus true unfinished comparator; next week/another date/that date stay complete.
Date complete plus unfinished TIME or administrative question; date class must remain complete.
Negated/quoted/conditional complete date; polarity must not be mistaken for completion.
Nonterminal hesitation followed by complete same/sibling date; ordered correction tracked independently.
One target unfinished while another has complete date; annotate both and preserve target uncertainty.
Complete impossible or weekday-conflicting calendar expression; normalization failure separate.
Actual linked turn continuation versus unanchored fragment; same utterance in different preceding contexts shares root.
Date-like security answer, clock digits, card/account suffix, puzzle numbers: reviewed detector negatives/unsupported contexts, not date unfinished labels.

controls.definition: Both constant scores on same aligned candidates; no accuracy-only claim under class imbalance.
controls.name: always_complete_and_always_unfinished

controls.definition: Estimate class prior per phase/question role from TRAIN canonical-group weights with global TRAIN fallback; report unseen context separately.
controls.name: TRAIN_phase_only

controls.definition: Same candidate/local lexical window and model/config, omit phase/question/continuation features; detector held identical. This removes learned context, not all detector context.
controls.name: text_only

controls.definition: Same loss/vocabulary cap but no neighboring clauses, to test whether right/left scoped context helps.
controls.name: candidate_surface_only

controls.definition: Frozen lexical/open-complement rule baseline on same candidate inputs; ellipsis alone cannot define unfinished.
controls.name: deterministic_fragment_baseline

controls.definition: Proposed CPU candidate head with permitted metadata; compare paired group outcomes with controls.
controls.name: full_local_context

controls.definition: Seed4313 randomly flips all binary labels within each canonical TRAIN group with probability1/2; preserves group/contrast dependencies. Report realized class balance; no reselection to improve result. This is a negative control, not an exact randomization p-value.
controls.name: group_null

data_collection.actual_detector_annotation: After source annotations frozen, attach frozen detector outputs and exact-span alignments. Review unmatched candidates and absent regions as a separate task; preserve original meanings. No detector-conditioned relabeling of missed gold to make predictions correct.
data_collection.authoring: New origins and constructions must be independently conceived before seeing candidate predictions. Store author/model/prompt/source hashes and actual delivered turns; source-author independence is not proven by a reviewer.
data_collection.dev: Separate reviewed dev roots with same axes and actual detector outputs. Used only for model diagnosis/selection; no calibration/risk/qualification claims. Freeze future qualification only after selected pipeline; never backfill it from these reviews.
data_collection.floor: At least20 fully independently reviewed/adjudicated canonical TRAIN groups with complete examples AND20 with unfinished examples. SAME paired roots may contribute to both class-support counts; total independent denominator counts each once. This differs from primary20 additional-negative-root gate. No IID claim follows.
data_collection.independent_annotation: Two non-author reviewers annotate full source clause/date spans and completion before model/detector output exposure; preserve uncertainties and adjudication. Existing exposed reviews inform guidelines, not counterfeit fresh blind annotations.
data_collection.lineage: Complete/unfinished/context/punctuation variants share root. Union reused carriers, source episodes and descendants across old/new packs before split. Never turn24 recipe variations from one carrier into24 groups. If unions leave fewer than20, gather new roots or keep readiness closed.
data_collection.target: 24 genuinely new conservatively grouped TRAIN roots, each aiming2-4 reviewed members;8 separately conceived dev roots;8 no-date/competing-kind detector-regression roots. Targets only, never claim achieved counts.

interfaces: project existing Component(name=date,completion=complete|unfinished,polarity=unknown or independently supported,evidence=actual_span,confidence.decision=abstain); unresolved scope stays unresolved

labels.absent: Reviewed absence used in detector regression denominators, not forced complete/unfinished target.
labels.continuation: A fragment completing prior text requires an exact prior unresolved source-event link and component token. Without it, mark unsupported_context; no synthetic concatenation from future turns.
labels.masked: Linguistic finishedness disputed/ambiguous, unknown source framing, unreviewed span, unisolated secret, unsupported detector role, or normalization-only dispute mistakenly offered as negative.
labels.negative: Genuinely unfinished date expression judged from delivered current source plus admissible prior context; not punctuation alone or the authors intended future script.
labels.positive: Linguistically complete date expression, even if vague, invalid, conditional, quoted or unresolved anaphor. Those other axes remain separate.

cpu_date_completion_pilot_v3.learned_scope: Exactly one binary head: complete DATE expression versus unfinished DATE expression, conditional on actual supported detector candidate. No added ontology/wire heads, no learned date values, target identity, consent or bank permissions.
cpu_date_completion_pilot_v3.metrics: Report detector typed exact-span recall and false candidates on all reviewed turns first. Then completion balanced accuracy, per-class recall and group-average CE conditional on exact matches. Pipeline denominator includes missed true spans; separately false complete proposals on unfinished/nondate groups, scoped pair consistency and unknown/overflow abstentions. Group macro averages and all-member-correct counts; no pseudo-independent span CI.

minimal_model.features: Binary word1/2-grams and bounded character3/4-grams from candidate/local clause left and right windows; open-complement/word-boundary/punctuation-position indicators. Optional phase/question-role categorical features and trusted linked-continuation flag. No IDs, canonical dates, gold spans/labels, future turns or global any-no/not flags.
minimal_model.limits: Initial vocabulary<=512features, input<=4096codepoints, actual candidate<=512codepoints, left/right max96codepoints WITH explicit boundary clipping indicators. If required predicate/dependency falls outside window, abstain rather than silently treating clipped context as complete.
minimal_model.no_extra_head: Typed deterministic proposer/guards supply candidate eligibility; do not add unreviewed learned validity/target/negation heads to rescue this pilot.
minimal_model.objective: L=(1/|G_h|)sum_g (1/|E_g,h|)sum_e (1/|C_e,h|)sum_c BCE(y_c,sigmoid(z_c)) + .0002/2*||w||^2. Only adjudicated matched candidates with mask1 enter. Report excluded/missed group/example/candidate counts; zero-eligible group cannot appear in loss denominator.
minimal_model.train: Deterministic CPU sparse logistic binary CE, L2=.0002,80epochs, fixed seed1729;80 is an initial bounded config, not optimized. No encoder/GPU required.
minimal_model.weighting: Each root equal mass, then each source example, then candidates; many spans/descendants cannot dominate. Start unweighted classes. Optional cost-sensitive run only if predeclared as separate control; scores remain uncalibrated.

cpu_date_completion_pilot_v3.progression: CPU fit is permitted only after actual review/closure floor; until then implementation and hand-labelled engineering fixtures test mechanics only. Useful dev improvement must exceed relevant constants/phase/fragment controls and survive hard-negative groups. It is exploratory, not calibration. Freeze detector+features+model+decoder+schema then obtain independent calibration-fit/risk/qualification evidence.
cpu_date_completion_pilot_v3.status: PROPOSED; no new data/fit/results. All outputs remain descriptive shadow abstentions.

date_completion_subset_experiment.candidate_detection: Measure exact-span/covered-span recall before classifier accuracy. Extend candidate evidence to include relevant open complements/punctuation and right context without absorbing a later sibling. Report missed gold spans, false candidate spans and ambiguity. Do not rely on oracle-span scores as end-to-end competence.
date_completion_subset_experiment.checkpoint06_execution_spec: See cpu_date_completion_pilot_v3 for concrete CPU model/controls/reviewed data admission; no experiment results yet.
date_completion_subset_experiment.collection_target: A versioned exploratory extension aiming24conservatively grouped TRAIN roots and8separate development roots,2-3context/wording variants per root. This is a collection target, not an achieved count: merge reused templates/carriers and report fewer groups if appropriate. Seek at least20independently reviewed complete and20unfinished class groups before claiming the engineering data screen for this binary subset; ambiguous cases are separately masked/adjudicated.

construction_axes.scope: Only independently judged open date complement is unfinished; do not label arbitrary truncations from script intent.
Date may remain complete while time is unfinished; whole-turn partial is not date-negative.
Complete vague period stays linguistically complete with unresolved exact day; truly open comparison is unfinished/ambiguous after review.
Expression can be complete in all; resolution differs. Do not generate completeness labels by context availability alone.
Complete date spans with different polarity/commitment; not automatic unfinished negatives.
First two require per-clause/component scope. Bare trailing ellipsis may be hesitation or continuation: adjudicate/mask ambiguity, do not force unfinished from punctuation.
surfaces: the message said on the...; I choose Monday

construction_axes.scope: Complete expression; deterministic invalid/conflicting normalization, not unfinished or vague fallback.
Explicit repair direction changes effective current date; every component span and correction relation labelled, no last serialized row shortcut.

date_completion_subset_experiment.current_gap: Final TRAIN complete date49rows/22groups, unfinished1row/1group, ambiguous12/12. Reviewed gold still0 at final-fit snapshot. Reweighting or GPU cannot manufacture missing negative constructions or repair label-axis disagreement.
experiment_ladder: Adjudicate label-axis semantics and obtain real reviewed negatives; preserve old data/model.
Measure always-complete, lexical-fragment baseline, existing CPU and clause-local CPU at the same new development groups; include per-class recall and failure roots.
Freeze candidate detector+classifier+export before separate calibration/risk; final qualification remains new and blind.
If reviewed data and CPU comparison show a plausible representation bottleneck, consider one bounded teacher/comparator on the SAME narrow labels; no need to train all rare heads.
date_completion_subset_experiment.features_now: Small CPU candidate classifier with span tokens, bounded left AND right local context, clause-boundary indicators, current question role and explicit source-grounded reference relations. Candidate generation is an independent versioned component; no hardcoded day/date/amount fixtures. Whole-turn bag words may remain a comparator, not the only scope signal.
date_completion_subset_experiment.gpu_interpretation: Zero currently accepted runtime frames does not by itself prohibit offline GPU research. Launch still needs actual reviewed-label quality, justified expected representation benefit, verified bounded training adapter/SDK/wall-stop and parent reservation. Phone raw ingress/consent/deployment qualification remains a separate gate; GPU improvement does not close it.
date_completion_subset_experiment.loss: Masked binary CE for adjudicated complete vs unfinished; genuinely ambiguous or axis-disputed items are not forced negatives. Compute average loss within lineage group then average groups, separately per head. Start equal head weights; optionally predeclared inverse-sqrt TRAIN-group class weights capped5 versus unweighted baseline. Never multiply rare variants into independent weight.
date_completion_subset_experiment.masks: Train only the narrow supported completion subset; act completion, target identity, offer/consent and unreviewed rare intent heads stay masked. Date-complete logits cannot authorize normalization or clear a kernel pending obligation by themselves.
date_completion_subset_experiment.optional_pair_loss: Only on adjudicated complete/unfinished pairs for the SAME semantic component and genuinely comparable context, add lambda*max(0,margin-z_complete+z_unfinished), e.g. predeclared lambda=.1,margin=1. No such constraint on complete-vague vs complete-exact, negated vsasserted, or date-complete/time-unfinished. Group the pair and retain a no-pair-loss control.
date_completion_subset_experiment.target: Scoped date-expression completion conditioned on actual candidate span and clause context. Separate it from act completion and deterministic unique-date normalization.

three_axes.act: Did the customer complete/assert the relevant act?
three_axes.expression: Is the date expression linguistically complete, unfinished, or genuinely ambiguous?
three_axes.normalization: Does the complete expression yield one consistent policy-valid date, a vague range, unresolved reference, invalid/conflicting expression or exact_unparsed form?

v3_lineage_review_contract.canonical_id_rule: Lexically minimal original group ID per transitive union; keep original IDs/reasons. Names do not prove IID independence.
feasible_supplement: Keep81-row packet immutable during review. Supplement missing closure CSv2-E-0073, joining giant root, plus any later union descendants.
Union-only selected18 positives can gain omitted existing root CSv2-G-1dc5c5cd2584d9fb (row0109) and at least one genuinely new positive root; possible20, not achieved20.

With disputed-primary masks existing whole pool18 positives requires at least2 genuinely new positive roots; arrange4 new independently conceived roots as bounded buffer, then merge skeleton collisions and count actual labels.

Vary discourse construction: self-initiated plan narration, open capacity-question answer, own intention versus third-party quote, and repaired proposal with reviewed primary still proposal. Numeric substitutions/new author alone cannot create independent roots.

Every member reviewed; complete/unfinished/quoted/negated variants stay same root. Existing20 additional negatives also require review; masks or mixed labels can reduce them, requiring actual new negatives.
Gate requires >=20fully reviewed/adjudicated canonical positives and >=20additional negatives outside positive set; mixed groups count once overall. Engineering screen, not statistical certification.
Zeno annotations remain TRAIN. Parent verifies reviewer identity/exposure/evidence; self-declared registry flag insufficient. No promotion to calibration/risk/qualification.

interface.fail_closed: Missing closure, disputed unadjudicated member, mismatch, reviewer-evidence failure or deficient floor: admitted=false and no training rows.

proposed_unions.reason: Collective total-versus-each amount/date contrast; same three-products/day construction.
Identical I-will-pay-on date carrier; numeric-format versus impossible spelled date.
Repeated amount/product/day prospective payment carrier under a negated/refused sibling; existing giant group already joins equivalent paid/stop/hardship-preface extensions.

scaffold_findings: Weak author-stratified packet is label-free and not selected by model error; neither proves reviewer blinding.
assess_reviews counts original lineage_group_id and packet-only completeness: must use parent-pinned union and closure overlay before gate.
Current scaffold requires two verified blind non-author annotations per row plus independent conflict adjudication. Partly exposed prior audit cannot be promoted to a blind annotation.
fit_grouped averages rows then groups correctly only if supplied canonical groups; use same unions for feature frequencies.
Row-shuffled labels destroy family structure: name this weaker null and add group-compatible label-vector/permutation control where feasible.
source_binding: Pin exact source/packet/review/overlay hashes. Validate member input against source; no missing/duplicate/unknown IDs.
Union conversation/template/carrier/augmentation/contrast ancestry before sampling, splits, losses and counts. Cross-split union requires quarantine or regenerated split.
Full review means canonical-group closure in frozen source, not only selected packet rows. Every member has reviewed/masked status.

v3_shared_admissible_feature_contract.delexicalization: Apply lexical value abstraction before typed context serialization. Never regex-replace numbers across serialized target maps. Use relative relations current_question_target/sibling/unresolved and typed component statuses; if local aliases needed use consistent opaque aliases with target-permutation controls. Exact money/calendar values remain deterministic normalization input, not a hidden training label.

exact_source_paths.use: Exact current delivered user text and offsets, after explicit exclusion/redaction policy. No extractor rewrite promoted to trusted raw source.
Role and actual last spoken question text; IDs bind provenance only. Question text must also pass secret-value exclusion; no future assistant text.
Frozen enum; unknown/out-of-scope explicit abstention. Phase-only comparator required.
Validate unique actual indices and membership. Map symbolic relationships without exposing bank IDs/names/suffixes. Never assume targets[].target_index exists.
Read actual nested shape; typed status and component names may be features. Opaque revision tokens go to deterministic freshness decoder, never lexical model features.

Only independently checked presence, kind, completed speech, current-versus-superseded relation and question-linked scope are categorical features. Exact IDs, amounts/dates and registry revisions are decoder/provenance data, not labels.
Date experiment markers from frozen proposer, never manually supplied gold spans in deployment. Exact source-map alignment; clipping/overflow explicit.

forbidden: future turns, actor intended completion and unseen response scripts
gold oracle spans in true-pipeline metrics
absolute example/group/source IDs, UUIDs, bank account/card identifiers, filename/split labels
DOB/security-answer values including number words in user, assistant question, offer text or cached embeddings
opaque revision strings or hashes as predictive tokens
a flat union of target statuses losing which dependency belongs to which target
parity_controls: Actual frozen input with targets[].index and nested pending components must serialize successfully without flattening statuses.
Renaming source IDs and permuting target enumeration with relationships preserved must preserve semantic model input/prediction up to alias canonicalization.
Same turn different valid question role should differ only in admissible role/question features; same phase with changed reference validity tests phase confounding.
No forbidden secret-word/number token in admitted input, feature vocabulary or embedding cache; unknown secret isolation excludes row.
Teacher input/CPU features derive from identical source view; teacher must not receive hidden canonical terms, full future context or gold spans.
v3_shared_admissible_feature_contract.privacy: For this minimal experiment include only source-proven fictional NON-security rows containing no DOB/answer content, even in mixed payment/admin turns. Metadata source eligibility is a dataset admission filter, not a learned feature. No raw security training/cache/logging or teacher calls. Question.role!=security alone is insufficient. If value-free projection cannot be established, exclude/mask the row and report lost coverage; do not claim a deployed perfect redactor. General raw-voice privacy/ingress remain unqualified.
v3_shared_admissible_feature_contract.shared_function: make_admissible_view_v3(snapshot,actual_candidate_or_none,trusted_fixture_context,feature_contract)->{text,structured_features,source_map,eligibility,reasons}; teacher and student consume this SAME versioned view.
v3_shared_admissible_feature_contract.source_map: Each lexical segment maps to original turn or actual spoken-question event and offsets. Synthetic role/candidate markers identified as markers with no source span. IDs/digests in manifest only, not model text. No raw-text hashes of short security values. Model/data artifact SHA256 remains valid provenance.

detector_regression_scope: Eight additional no-date/competing-kind roots in the design are not authored in this assigned 24+8 completion pilot; do not claim detector regression coverage.

feature_policy.allowed: input only with versioned v3 lexical/value abstraction and typed target relations; oracle annotations and source metadata never features.
feature_policy.new_row_admission: All NEW source fixtures are non-security, synthetic and contain no DOB/phone answer values.
feature_policy.old_review_rows_admission: NOT feature-admitted by this collection. Earlier packet contains security/identity fixtures; parent must apply the v3 source eligibility contract before any features/cache/upload.

generator_model_version: inherited-workhorse fallback; exact version not available; no GPT-5.6 claim
identity_policy: Opaque class-neutral NEW example/group/root/episode/carrier IDs. Author key, root descriptions, rationale and nominations live only in this admin manifest. Earlier frozen source IDs are preserved.

identity_repack.reason: Explicit user request for opaque class-neutral prereview identities; source content frozen.

lineage.canonical_id_rule: Lexically minimum original ID in transitive union; preserve declared root IDs.
lineage.limitation: Shared author and policy; distinct scene IDs do not prove IID roots. Fresh documentary carrier collisions are conservatively united.

new_union_edges.reason: Conservative shared target-distributive date carrier, despite fresh sequence narration.
Conservative alternative amount/date prospective-payment carrier overlap with giant TRAIN root.
Quoted document ordinal-date versus open month complement shares a documentary carrier.
Payment-note calendar-error contrasts share a documentary date carrier; invalidity types remain separate annotations.

Customer narrates two deliberately staggered actions rather than accepting a single offered term.
Customer independently assigns proceeds of a specific fictional sale to the full overdue amount.
Speaker describes their own chosen future bank-transfer action with an explicit amount.
A speaker contrasts their usual procrastination with a new present intention.
Independent lower-amount proposal in a negative answer to the actual today question.
Self-repair of a freshly volunteered plan, without responding to an agent readback.
A personal pledge distinguishes the speaker’s own act from a quoted adviser suggestion.
Human-transfer request dominates a separately volunteered secondary payment statement.
Hypothetical payment is embedded in an information question, not adopted as a proposal.
Withdrawal of the speaker’s prior volunteered plan, without a replacement proposal.
Negated payment predicate is followed by the speaker’s actual balance question.
An own wall-calendar entry specifies a named payment day.
A week-long budgeting period contrasts with an unfinished comparison.
A date is copied from an invoice’s payment field, never a birthday.
Callback question answered by the intended person with an unfinished clock time.
Same complete ordinal has one, zero, or two admissible prior spoken offer referents.
Two product lanes have separately scoped dates.
Deposit condition qualifies the predicate, not the completed date phrase.
A quoted reminder is reported by the customer rather than asserted as their own proposal.
Rejected date versus open rejected complement; rejection does not imply incompletion.
A nonterminal hesitation is followed by an explicit same-turn completed sibling.
A fully uttered impossible calendar day differs from an open month complement.
Weekday/date conflict is complete, while missing month is unfinished.
Correction direction is semantic evidence and can leave an open current revision.
An actual prior unresolved complement can be completed only through a fixture-bound prior-event link.
Two endpoints of a payment window versus an open second endpoint.
A relational date uses an actually stated source anchor, with no implied exact calendar invention.
Business-day ordinal is semantically complete without silently selecting a month.
Month-end noun phrase and its incomplete genitive differ in delivered meaning.
Deictic date remains complete when a unique external anchor is absent.
Completed date survives an unfinished independent administrative question.
Numeric locale uncertainty is resolution ambiguity rather than expression incompletion.
Explicitly started year cannot be filled from a yearless alternative or fixture clock.
A completed choice has unresolved selection, whereas the alternative complement is still open.
Evening date complement is unfinished with no ellipsis at all.
A countdown tied to an unnamed milestone; no TRAIN relational phrase is reused.
Customer defines a deadline through a duration following a move-in event.
Event-closing noun phrase provides a complete but externally unresolved day.
Possessive anaphor points to an independently spoken dated appointment, not a payment offer.
Reported rejected due-date text from a printed schedule uses a fresh subordinate construction.
Two pages assign independent payment dates; a correction opens the second page only.
Sunday is fixed independently of an uncompleted clock-reading choice.
An eclipse period is complete vague timing, with a dangling possessive contrast.
